attempted_claim: Let C_CM over the fixed field K = Q be the smooth projective genus-2 curve with affine model y^2 = x^5 + 1 (CM Jacobian, bad reduction only at 2 and 5), and let X -> Spec Z be its minimal regular model with normalized Arakelov self-intersection obar^2 = (omega,omega)_{Ar}. Let M = log(2)/3, i.e. twice Moriwaki's universal reducible-fiber quantum log(2)/6, testing additivity of the two bad fibers. Decide with proof whether obar^2 >= M or obar^2 < M. A complete answer gives Liu's reduction types and intersection matrices at 2 and 5 (including any non-reduced or three-component fiber outside the Kuhn-Muller two-component census), evaluates the finite local terms exactly from the matrices, bounds the archimedean delta term via Wilms/de Jong to absolute error at most 0.05, declares the side, and names which of the two fibers dominates the finite contribution.
decisive_failure: The wild prime-2 regular model and both exact Liu intersection matrices remain uncomputed, and no Wilms/de Jong archimedean delta interval to absolute error 0.05 was produced; available offline tooling cannot certify the period-matrix, theta-constant, analytic-torsion, or Colmez-height inputs the target requires.
